qa_pair.question: Using the shared three-vendor scenario, which vendor has the lowest Effective Net Unit Cost on the award basis?

In the shared scenario, Vendor B places an analyser worth 2,400,000,000 free of charge while Vendor A requires the hospital to buy the same instrument outright. Once the placement and the reagent pricing are both accounted for, which of the two has the lower Effective Net Unit Cost on Ledger A?

In the shared scenario, Vendor B offers a headline top-tier rebate of 6%. After probability weighting, breakage, off-invoice tax treatment and the collection lag, what is the effective net rebate rate, rounded to one decimal place as a percentage?
In the shared scenario, does including sponsorship in the comparison change any vendor's rank relative to the award basis? Answer yes or no.
For the shared scenario, what is the annual rupiah value of choosing the best offer over the worst on the award basis, rounded to the nearest million?
With a WACC of 12%, how many days of additional payment terms are worth the same as a 1% reduction in price? Give the answer to one decimal place.
Using the shared scenario parameters, how many percentage points of off-invoice rebate are worth the same as one percentage point of on-invoice discount? Give the answer to two decimal places.
An offer is on the table at an ENUC of 86,534.55. The target is 76,000, the reservation price is 88,000, the BATNA is 81,000 and there is no switching cost. What verdict does the engine return?

A principal raises a list price from 100,000 to 112,000. The item is on net binding and the current discount is 20%. What discount is required to hold the net price, as a percentage to two decimal places?

A contract needs 58,000 units to reach its rebate tier. Nine months in, monthly volumes have been 4,600, 4,750, 5,100, 4,900, 5,200, 4,800, 5,050, 5,300 and 4,950 units. Will the tier be met by year end based on the run rate? Answer yes or no.
Using the price book, what target net price per clinical unit should Siloam aim for on IV cannula 22G (Prima) from Prima Alkes? Round to two decimal places.
For that same IV cannula negotiation, which vendor's price sets the lowest reference that the target has to beat?
Which SKU in the price book has the largest annual savings opportunity against the best available price?
Which vendor has raised a price well above the inflation index over the past year, triggering a price-creep alert?
Which Siloam site pays the most per unit for Troponin I reagent (Sehat) over the last 12 months?
Medisindo offers Ceftriaxone 1 g injection at 13,000 per vial. Does that beat every historical, internal and competitor reference? Answer with the engine's status.
